gaps.what: No page dates the county's start (987 is a bridge, confidence 1) or the 1003 Sens-Joigny block that Cliopatria gives Champagne; the extent is the Yonne without Auxerre, not the wider pagus of the Senones; no English article exists

12th-century losses to Liège, Brabant and Hainaut, Baldwin V of Hainaut's inheritance (1189) and the Hainaut/Courtenay interval are undated; the dossier ends at 1429 although the page says the county lasted to about 1790 as a title
Calenberg, ceded to John in 1665, is not drawn because no page dates its acquisition by the Celle line; split year 1267/1269 and seat move 1371/1378 differ within one page; no ruler strip

The Italian occupation of Dalmatia and western Carniola 1918-1921 continues in the successor yugoslavia, which has no event for it; Fiume, Međimurje and the Carinthian and Styrian frontiers are not on the pages opened

The dossier ends at the Unification Act of 22 January 1919 although the Western Oblast and the Galician Army lasted to July 1919 and an exile government to 1923; Bukovina and Carpathian Ruthenia were claimed but never held

problems: OVERLAP: duchy-of-brunswick-luneburg (eu-09-x, 1235..1807) draws the same Lüneburg line as principality-of-luneburg for 1269..1705 and records 'loss electorate-of-hanover 1705'; the compiler should draw the principality on this land.

OVERLAP: burgundian-state and duchy-of-burgundy both record a 1429 gain of Namur from 'County of Namur' (a name, not the slug county-of-namur); county-of-namur dissolves in 1429 with burgundian-state as counterpart.

MISMATCH: county-of-flanders draws only a 25 km disc round Namur (1,770 km2) for its 1264 gain and 1305 loss, while county-of-namur removes and restores the whole province (4,046 km2); house-of-luxembourg draws the Namur lands from 1260 only, the Henry V page puts the seizure in 1256; the sale to Guy is 1263 on the County of Namur page and 1264 on the Guy and Henry V pages.

MISMATCH: second-polish-republic records the Eastern Galicia contest and the 18 July 1919 gain against ukrainian-people-s-republic; until the union of 22 January 1919 the counterpart should be west-ukrainian-people-s-republic, and a gain of Lviv on 21 November 1918 is missing there.

MISMATCH: second-polish-republic draws Central Lithuania as a 60 km vassal disc and a 100 km annexation disc and kingdom-of-lithuania a 47 km loss disc; central-lithuania uses 60 km (about 13,150 km2 against the infobox 13,490 km2); the annexation is 22 March 1922 (Polish Sejm, text), 18 April 1922 (infobox) or 24 March 1922 (second-polish-republic).
MISMATCH: the austria-hungary splits hand Vukovar-Srijem (Syrmia) to both state-of-slovenes-croats-and-serbs and serbs; state-of-slovenes-croats-and-serbs loses it to serbs on 24 November 1918.

yugoslavia has no event for the Italian occupation of Dalmatia and western Carniola 1918-1921; state-of-slovenes-croats-and-serbs closes its occupation record with the state on 1 December 1918 (confidence 1).

Three contest_end events (county-of-sens 1015, west-ukrainian-people-s-republic January 1919, and the occupation_end of state-of-slovenes-croats-and-serbs) are bridges that close a record with the state, at confidence 1, because the validator pairs every _start with an _end.

county-of-sens: the English Wikipedia has no article for the county (County_of_Sens and Count_of_Sens both url_not_found); fr:Comté de Sens was used and wikipedia is null. wikidata is null in all six dossiers (no page read gives an id; wikidata.org is unreachable).

WebFetch answers through a summarising model: quotes in notes are as it returned them, not checked against the raw page text; the French and diacritic spellings were corrected by hand where the summary mangled them.
